title: Cross-room carry Stage B: loaded single red box, west pickup room -> divider door -> zone B arrival
policy_source_commit_note: visgoal candidate C build (PR #582 draft), vendored byte copy; Stage B uses the same expanded-search + r4-arrival-declaration policy as Stage A.

scene.scenario: crossroom_carry_scene_v1 (single red box; default-off reduced scene, no long_beam, end-color profile off)
scene.scene_toggle: crossroom_carry_scene_v1=on (default off in code; this queue turns it on)
scene.host_note: same L4 host as Stage A and visgoal; different scene/cap/stage so results are not pooled.

cargo.start_state: held in the closed gripper from t=0 (setup only)

setup.place_method: the box free joint is placed at the r1 grip site with the arm in the calibrated SEARCH joints and the gripper commanded closed; the CPU solver settles the grasp for 1 Sim s before the batch starts; no teacher and no weld after t=0
setup.setup_validation: experiments/2026-10-18-crossroom-carry/setup-validation-B.json (16/16 starts: box stays at the gripper site through the 1 Sim s settle)

own_monitor.inputs: own raw fisheye RGB lower-centre ROI + own issued gripper pulse history
own_monitor.thresholds: frozen by the Stage B preflight and recorded in the queue/stack.json; not tuned from gate episodes

mission_success_definition: arrived_declared=true AND gt_cargo_in_zone_at_declared=true AND cargo_held_own_at_arrival='held'. This is loaded arrival only, not full-mission delivery: release/gt_delivered are out of scope (B+ after ACT release gate).
cap_end_note: cap_end is a separate termination label, never a rejection reason; the 180 Sim s cap is not pooled with the visgoal 120 Sim s runs or with Stage A.
eval_only: separate cells only; the controller never receives gt_*, cargo world pose, spawn pose, static map, top camera or zone/door coordinates

input_audit.implementation: controller_boundary_v1: every skill.control/memory_observation/memory.step argument dict is scanned at the boundary; forbidden-key attempts are counted and fail the episode as input_audit_fail. held_world_reads counts actual boundary attempts, not a runner constant.

mission_scope: Stage B measures loaded arrival only (box carried from t=0, no grasp). Release and gt_delivered are B+ after an ACT release component gate; full mission (grasp+carry+release) is not verified by this stage.
expected_wall: 16 worlds x 180 Sim s at the gcp3 batch rate is about 2.5-3.1 h, plus the 1 Sim s CPU settle per world at scene setup.

stage_a_carryover.statement: Stage B uses the same search, gap-crossing and door-approach policy as Stage A with no fixes. The Stage A failure modes measured on 2026-10-18 (skill claimed a gap crossing in 9/16 while only 1/16 GT crossed the door; the single GT crossing had lateral offset -0.1634 m and min jamb clearance -0.1084 m; the declaration stopped 0.0281 m outside zone B; near-field blue end-bands gave false paint hints) carry over unchanged into Stage B. This gate is the loaded BASELINE measurement, not a fix, and its results are not pooled with Stage A or with the later crossroom-stageA-fix candidate.
stage_a_carryover.expected_effect: If the carry-over holds, the loaded run should also fail before destination search (gap trigger/door alignment); the loaded state may additionally lose/retain the box through door contact. Any success here would contradict the Stage A failure analysis and must be checked against the raw before being reported.

collision_events: not_measured in this baseline (the MJWarp raw carries no contact events; see Stage A analysis). The loaded door crossing records lateral offset and min jamb clearance instead; an explicit contact recorder is a crossroom-stageA-fix item.

cargo_own_thresholds_freeze.note: thresholds are the carry_state_own.py constants and are recorded in queue/stack.json; they are not tuned from gate episodes.
